test_title: PYST 8: SSC JE ME- General Intelligence (Held On 11 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Point G is 9 m to the west of Point H. Point B is 10 m to the north of Point H. Point A is 18 m to the west of Point B. Point C is 28 m to the north of Point A. Point C is 23 m to the west of Point D. Point E is 18 m to the south of Point D. Point F is 5 m to the west of Point E. What is the distance between Point H and Point F?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Point G is 9 m to the west of Point H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16dab1888cf2141b3185f477f7cb6ce67251cf09a45bdcc94533bb650b37df03.png] 

2) Point B is 10 m to the north of Point H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88b14edadef81dfb2da8ab10ec2642a1d74db72e72e489859c3779e9fa23a9c6.png] 

3) Point A is 18 m to the west of Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcf8876c4b562679e706db9b1caa58714ea4b4b7a96e3c6f824c11861fbc8b25.png] 

4) Point C is 28 m to the north of Point A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4abb934e773462451cd215b2d00a65b0e93af00e8b41d4685060a350b66ca640.png] 

5) Point C is 23 m to the west of Point D.

6) Point E is 18 m to the south of Point D.

7) Point F is 5 m to the west of Point E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fab60da6e27e3a8f6a98f370fd5b2c0a3c416f89dd1fafedb6c876ca5340bcc.png] 

Here, we can see that the distance between H and F = (10 + 10) = 20 m

Hence, the correct answer is **"****20 m"**.
